name: Green garlic
description: Young garlic pulled before the bulb splits — milder, greener, seasonal.

tcm.note: The allium group is warm and disperses cold; young garlic is gentler than the cured bulb.

ayurveda.note: Lashuna is ushna and tikshna — heating whatever its age.

unani.note: Garam-khushk, a winter vegetable in the desi kitchen.
